source_record.bounded_interface_domain: The receiving evidence method, operating scope, counterevidence or actual authority provides a specific premise or constraint on testing this countermeasure. source_record.domain_horizon_authority: The exact member object, configuration, observation interval, consequence and actual authority in each literal argument; no adoption or legal applicability inference.
source_record.evidence_ceiling: No singular-root guarantee, universal improvement, field causal effect or template efficacy follows. Intervention observations need their actual causal contrast. Analytical native-role inference only; no empirical effect size, universal benefit, new historical descent or final scientific acceptance.
source_record.common_cost_and_alternative: Investigation, safe experiments, alternative explanations, side effects, follow-up ownership and ability to act count. A trivial one-off reversible issue can receive a cheap fix and recorded observation; escalate when the actual uncertainty or recurrence warrants it.

positive_controls.argument: A feasible verification criterion supplies a testable observation and boundary for comparing the countermeasure prediction with results.
Cross-level evidence supplies discriminating observations and unintended effects that can reject a local causal explanation or narrow its scope.
Representative intended-use evidence supplies the actual outcome and adverse effects against which the countermeasure prediction must be judged.
Qualification conditions, representative configurations and anomaly evidence restrict extrapolation of the observed countermeasure effect.
Actual acceptance criteria and legitimate waiver limits specify which predicted outcomes and residual conditions the countermeasure must address before delivery.
The applicable basis constrains permissible experiments, accepted evidence and who may authorize the corrected configuration.
Competent separate challenge can expose confirmation bias, a confounded comparison or an excluded structural cause and change the proposed inquiry.
Hazard scenarios and severity constrain permissible testing and expose side-effect paths that a local countermeasure trial must address.
Claim decomposition identifies the exact causal proposition and untested assumptions the problem-solving inquiry must warrant.
Actual transition constraints and recovery evidence delimit safe experimentation, relevant outcomes and acceptable rollback conditions for the countermeasure.
Current versioned observations and exceptions provide follow-up evidence that can expose recurrence or invalidate a once-supported causal assumption.
Actual authority, residual constraints and controlled resources delimit feasible and permissible countermeasure tests and implementation.
